subject: Decision criteria clarification - latency, cost, deployment & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alice Morgan <alice.morgan@finova.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@finova.com>
Date: 2027-05-15T15:20:00Z
Subject: Decision criteria clarification - latency, cost, deployment & next steps

Hi Alice / Samir —

Thanks again for the time today — really helpful to understand Finova's use cases for conversational search and automated summaries. Quick recap and a few follow-ups so we can align internal stakeholders on next steps: 

1) Decision criteria we heard on the call (can you confirm/update?):
   - Latency target: p95 under 300ms for 512-token responses (real-time UI)
   - Cost target: target unit economics roughly $0.002/token (ballpark)
   - Deployment preference: evaluating Dedicated (reserved GPU) vs Private VPC for data residency/SOC2 reasons
   - SLA: goal is 99.9% uptime with clear latency SLO and escalation path

2) Stakeholder mapping (please confirm names/roles):
   - Economic buyer: Rahul Mehta (VP Eng) — final approver on spend
   - Security & compliance: you (Alice) + procurement (Samir) for questionnaire and legal
   - Technical evaluation: engineering/ML (we offered to loop in an SE)

3) Ask from our side: can you confirm the procurement timeline and preferred procurement steps (SOW/PO, standard redlines, any legal requirements)? Also please share the security questionnaire so our security team can start the review.

Next steps we propose:
- I’ll share a draft mutual action plan with milestones and dates (PoC -> procurement -> rollout)
- Loop in Rachel (solutions engineering) for a short tech-deep dive demo focused on latency/batching and quantization tradeoffs

I’ve attached a short Redwood one-pager for context. Happy to revise the summary above if I misunderstood anything.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
Attachments: redwood_one-pager.pdf
From: Alice Morgan <alice.morgan@finova.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@finova.com>
Date: 2027-05-16T09:08:00Z
Subject: Re: Decision criteria clarification - latency, cost, deployment & next steps

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap — mostly accurate, a few clarifications below: 

- Latency: our product team is targeting p95 < 300ms for 512-token responses in the user-facing search UI. For async batch summarization workloads latency is less strict but cost matters more.
- Cost: $0.002/token is roughly the internal target for the production inference path; tolerances exist for batch workloads.
- Deployment: security prefers VPC/private deployment for any PII-containing data; Dedicated (reserved) is acceptable for non-sensitive traffic. We need the security/compliance review to validate options.
- SLA: 99.9% is what procurement will ask for; we also want latency SLOs and a documented escalation process.

Stakeholders: correct on Rahul (VP Eng). Procurement lead is Samir (cc’d). I’ll be the point for security questions — attaching our standard security questionnaire (redacted).

Procurement timeline: goal is to complete technical validation and security review by the end of May, procurement/contract by mid-June. We may request a short PoC (2–4 weeks) before signing.

Attached: finova_security_questionnaire.pdf

Best,
Alice Morgan
Head of Product Security, Finova
Attachments: finova_security_questionnaire.pdf
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alice Morgan <alice.morgan@finova.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@finova.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-17T11:35:00Z
Subject: Re: Decision criteria clarification - latency, cost, deployment & next steps

Hi Alice / Samir —

Appreciate the clarifications — good to have the timeline and PoC expectation. Action items from our side: 

- I’ve attached a draft mutual action plan (MAP) with proposed milestones: 2-week PoC -> security review -> procurement -> production pilot. Please review and mark dates that work for you.
- Rachel (cc) will schedule a 60-minute tech deep dive to show a latency-focused demo (continuous batching, KV cache, p95 tuning) — proposed slots early next week.
- Vivek (cc) from our pricing team will put together a preliminary pricing model for Dedicated vs Private VPC that maps to the $0.002/token target and highlights breakpoints.

A couple of clarifying questions to help the MAP and internal approvals: 
1) For the PoC, will Finova want sample payloads and data residency constraints (EU-only) included, or should we run the PoC on Redwood hosted with synthetic data first?
2) Any specific legal contract items procurement wants prioritized (e.g., data residency, indemnity caps, subprocessing)?

We can also offer a short dedicated capacity pilot with a reduced monthly commit to prove p95 latency. If that’s interesting, we’ll include an estimate in the MAP.

Thanks — I’ll follow up with calendar invites and the MAP attached.

Best,
Marissa
Attachments: mutual_action_plan.xlsx
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@finova.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Alice Morgan <alice.morgan@finova.com>
Date: 2027-05-18T08:40:00Z
Subject: Re: Decision criteria clarification - latency, cost, deployment & next steps

Marissa / Alice —

Thanks — useful plan. Quick procurement notes from our side: 

- Timeline: target to issue PO / finalize contract by 2027-06-10, assuming PoC and security review complete in May.
- Legal/Compliance asks: SOC2 Type II report required, data residency (EU for EU customer data), and standard indemnity limits; we will surface detailed redlines after the security review.
- Pricing/procurement process: we prefer to start with a short-term PoC (billable) and then convert to a committed Dedicated SKU if performance and cost meet our thresholds.

I’ve also started a DocuSign envelope for our internal paperwork for PoC approval — link below. If you can provide SOC2 evidence and a standard SOW template, that will speed the process.

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/envelope/ABCD-1234

Samir Patel
Procurement Lead, Finova
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@finova.com>, Alice Morgan <alice.morgan@finova.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-18T12:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Decision criteria clarification - latency, cost, deployment & next steps

Thanks Samir — that timeline works. Quick commitments from our side: 

- We’ll provide SOC2 Type II evidence and a standard SOW template by EOD 2027-05-19.
- Rachel will reach out to schedule the tech deep dive (propose Mon/Tue next week).
- Vivek will share a Dedicated vs Private pricing note in the MAP; we’ll include an option for a short dedicated pilot commit.

I’ll update the MAP with the PoC dates and procurement milestone and send for your review. Looking forward to the tech deep dive.

Best,
Marissa
